build_provenance_requirements: Run from a clean isolated checkout at the selected exact revision with initialized submodules. Never mutate archived baseline files.
Create build/eng-artifacts/T36 before the commands; do not push images or publish packages.

Record base image digest, resolved apt package versions, compiler/linker, effective feature flags, lockfiles, binary hash and output manifest. Mutable Debian tags mean source pinning alone is insufficient reproducibility.
arm64 builds require the declared native arm64 runner. Dockerfile rejects amd64 to arm64 cross builds.
No cross-build or QEMU run proves physical performance; missing runners leave target qualification open.
